translations.idiomatic: " We ask that Shilong remain at Yongping, that the four eastern routes be divided between Shilong and Ying'e, and that the central and western commands be placed solely under Zushou at Santun."

sentences.zh: 」章下兵部，署事侍郎張經世議如其言，承宗堅執如初。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of War; Acting Minister Zhang Jingshi agreed with their words, but Chengzong held firmly to his original plan.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial went to the Ministry of War. Acting Minister Zhang Jingshi agreed with them, but Chengzong held to his original plan.

sentences.zh: 乃命祖壽移鎮遵化。

translations.literal: Zushou was then ordered to transfer command to Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: Zushou was then ordered to transfer his command to Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 七年，錦州告警，祖壽赴援，不敢戰，被劾罷歸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Jinzhou raised the alarm; Zushou went to its relief but dared not fight and was impeached, dismissed, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In year seven Jinzhou raised the alarm. Zushou went to its relief but dared not fight, was impeached, dismissed, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 及是都城被兵，散家財，招回部曲，從滿桂赴鬥，竟死，贈恤如制。

translations.literal: At this time when the capital was under attack, he dispersed his family wealth, recalled his old troops, followed Man Gui to battle, and in the end died; posthumous favors were granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital came under attack, he spent his family wealth, recalled his old troops, followed Man Gui into battle, and died. Posthumous honors were granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 祖壽初守固關，遘危疾，妻張氏割臂以療，絕飲食者七日。

translations.literal: When Zushou first defended Guguan he fell gravely ill; his wife Lady Zhang cut her arm to treat him and went without food or drink for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: When Zushou first defended Guguan he fell gravely ill. His wife Lady Zhang cut her arm to treat him and went without food or drink for seven days.

sentences.zh: 祖壽生，而張氏旋死，遂終身不近婦人。

translations.literal: Zushou lived, but Lady Zhang soon died, and from then on he never went near women.
translations.idiomatic: Zushou recovered, but Lady Zhang soon died, and he never went near women again for the rest of his life.

sentences.zh: 為大帥，部將以五百金遺其子於家，卻不受。

translations.literal: As supreme commander, a subordinate officer sent five hundred taels of gold to his son at home, but he refused it.
translations.idiomatic: As supreme commander, a subordinate sent five hundred taels of gold to his son at home, but the son refused it.

sentences.zh: 他日來省，賜之卮酒曰：「卻金一事，善體吾心，否則法不汝宥也。

translations.literal: Another day when the son came to visit, he gave him a cup of wine and said, "In refusing the gold you understood my heart well; otherwise the law would not spare you."
translations.idiomatic: Another day when his son came to visit, he gave him a cup of wine and said, "In refusing the gold you understood my heart. Otherwise the law would not spare you."

sentences.zh: 」其秉義執節如此。

translations.literal: " Such was his upholding of righteousness and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was his upholding of righteousness and integrity.

sentences.zh: 趙率教，陜西人。

translations.literal: Zhao Lujiao was a native of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Lujiao was from Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，歷官延綏參將，屢著戰功。

translations.literal: During Wanli he served through the post of assistant commander at Yan'an and Suide and repeatedly achieved merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign he served as assistant commander in the Yan'an-Suide region and repeatedly distinguished himself in battle.

sentences.zh: 已，劾罷。

translations.literal: Later he was impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was impeached and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 遼事急，詔廢將蓄家丁者赴軍前立功。

translations.literal: When Liaodong affairs grew urgent, an edict summoned dismissed generals who kept household retainers to come to the army and earn merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liaodong crisis grew urgent, an edict summoned dismissed generals who kept household retainers to come to the front and earn merit.

sentences.zh: 率教受知於經略袁應泰，擢副總兵，典中軍事。

translations.literal: Lujiao won the notice of Commissioner Yuan Yingtai, was promoted to vice commander-in-chief, and directed central-army affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao won Yuan Yingtai's notice, was promoted to vice commander-in-chief, and directed central-army affairs.

sentences.zh: 蒙古虎墩兔素為總督王象乾所撫。

translations.literal: The Mongol Huduntai had long been pacified by Governor-in-chief Wang Xiangqian.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Huduntai had long been under Governor-in-chief Wang Xiangqian's pacification.

sentences.zh: 其部下抽扣兒者，善為盜，率教捕斬四人。

translations.literal: Among his followers Choukou'er was skilled at robbery; Lujiao captured and beheaded four men.
translations.idiomatic: Among his followers Choukou'er was skilled at robbery. Lujiao captured and beheaded four men.

sentences.zh: 招撫僉事萬有孚與率教有隙，遂以故敗款事訴之象乾。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Wan Youfu was at odds with Lujiao and therefore reported to Xiangqian the matter of breaking the peace agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Wan Youfu was at odds with Lujiao and reported to Xiangqian that he had broken the peace agreement.

sentences.zh: 象乾告兵部尚書董漢儒，將斬之，賴承宗貽書漢儒，得不死。

translations.literal: Xiangqian reported to Minister of War Dong Hanru, who was about to execute him; thanks to Chengzong's letter to Hanru, he was not put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian reported to Minister of War Dong Hanru, who was about to execute him. Thanks to a letter from Chengzong, he was spared.

sentences.zh: 時承宗分關內外為五部。

translations.literal: At that time Chengzong divided the territory inside and outside the pass into five divisions.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chengzong divided the territory inside and outside the pass into five divisions.

sentences.zh: 以馬世龍、王世欽、尤世祿領中、左、右部，而令率教與副將孫諫領前、後部，部各萬五千人。

translations.literal: He put Ma Shilong, Wang Shiqin, and You Shilu in charge of the central, left, and right divisions, and ordered Lujiao and Vice Commander Sun Jian to command the front and rear divisions, each division having fifteen thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: He put Ma Shilong, Wang Shiqin, and You Shilu in charge of the central, left, and right divisions, and ordered Lujiao and Vice Commander Sun Jian to command the front and rear divisions, each with fifteen thousand men.

sentences.zh: 率教仍駐前屯。

translations.literal: Lujiao still garrisoned Qiantun.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao remained garrisoned at Qiantun.

sentences.zh: 四年九月，承宗暴其功於朝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year Chengzong displayed his achievements at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year four Chengzong reported his achievements to court.

sentences.zh: 擢署都督僉事，加銜總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Acting Vice Commissioner-in-chief and given the added title of regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Acting Vice Commissioner and given the added title of regional commander.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，承宗去，高第來代，諸將多所更置。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year Chengzong departed and Gao Di came to replace him; many generals were reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year five Chengzong left and Gao Di replaced him. Many generals were reassigned.

sentences.zh: 率教善事第，第亦委信之。

translations.literal: Lujiao served Di well, and Di also entrusted him.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao served Di well, and Di trusted him in return.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，蒙古以寧遠被圍，乘間入犯平川、三山堡。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, because Ningyuan was besieged, Mongols seized the opportunity to invade Pingchuan and Sanshan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year six, while Ningyuan was besieged, Mongols seized the opportunity to invade Pingchuan and Sanshan Fort.

sentences.zh: 率教禦之，斬首百余級，奪馬二百匹，追至高臺堡乃還。

translations.literal: Lujiao resisted them, took more than a hundred heads, seized two hundred horses, and pursued as far as Gaotai Fort before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao resisted them, took more than a hundred heads, seized two hundred horses, and pursued as far as Gaotai Fort before returning.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，帝大喜，立擢都督同知，實授總兵官，代楊麒鎮山海關。

translations.literal: When victory was reported the emperor was greatly pleased, immediately promoted him to Vice Commissioner-in-chief of the Chief Military Commission, formally appointed him regional commander, and had him replace Yang Qi in commanding Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported the emperor was greatly pleased. He immediately promoted Lujiao to Vice Commissioner, formally appointed him regional commander, and sent him to replace Yang Qi at Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 尋論功，再進右都督，世蔭本衛副千戶。

translations.literal: Soon merit was discussed again; he was advanced to Right Chief Commander with hereditary enfeoffment as vice chiliarch of his original guard.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was discussed again he was advanced to Right Chief Commander with a hereditary vice chiliarch enfeoffment in his original guard.

sentences.zh: 時滿桂守寧遠，亦有盛名，與率教深相得。

translations.literal: At that time Man Gui defended Ningyuan and also had great fame; he and Lujiao were on very close terms.
translations.idiomatic: Man Gui was then defending Ningyuan and also enjoyed great fame. He and Lujiao were on very close terms.

sentences.zh: 及寧遠被圍，率教遣一都司、四守備東援。

translations.literal: When Ningyuan was besieged, Lujiao sent one battalion commander and four garrison commanders east to its relief.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningyuan was besieged, Lujiao sent one battalion commander and four garrison commanders east to its relief.

sentences.zh: 桂惡其稽緩，拒不納，以袁崇煥言，乃令入。

translations.literal: Gui hated their delay and refused to admit them; only on Yuan Chonghuan's word were they allowed in.
translations.idiomatic: Gui resented their delay and refused to admit them. Only on Yuan Chonghuan's word were they allowed in.

sentences.zh: 既解圍，率教欲分功。

translations.literal: After the siege was lifted, Lujiao wished to share in the merit.
translations.idiomatic: After the siege was lifted, Lujiao wanted a share of the credit.

sentences.zh: 桂不許，且責其不親援，兩人遂有隙。

translations.literal: Gui would not allow it and also reproached him for not coming in person to the relief; the two men then had a rift.
translations.idiomatic: Gui refused and reproached him for not coming in person. The two men fell out.

sentences.zh: 中朝聞之，下敕戒諭。

translations.literal: The court heard of it and issued an edict of admonition.
translations.idiomatic: The court heard of it and issued an edict of admonition.

sentences.zh: 而桂又與崇煥不和。

translations.literal: But Gui was again at odds with Chonghuan.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was again at odds with Chonghuan as well.

sentences.zh: 乃召還桂，令率教盡統關內外兵，移鎮寧遠。

translations.literal: Gui was then recalled, and Lujiao was ordered to take overall command of all troops inside and outside the pass and transfer to Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was recalled, and Lujiao was ordered to take overall command of all troops inside and outside the pass and transfer to Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，大清兵南征朝鮮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year Qing troops marched south against Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year seven Qing troops marched south against Korea.

sentences.zh: 率教督兵抵三岔河為牽制，卒無功。

translations.literal: Lujiao supervised troops to reach Sancha River as a diversion, but in the end achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao led troops to Sancha River to create a diversion but achieved nothing in the end.

sentences.zh: 三月，崇煥議修築錦州、大淩河、中左所三城，漸圖恢復。

translations.literal: In the third month Chonghuan proposed building the three cities of Jinzhou, Daling River, and Zhongzuosuo, gradually planning recovery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Chonghuan proposed building Jinzhou, Daling River, and Zhongzuosuo as a gradual plan for recovery.

sentences.zh: 率教移鎮錦州護工，再加左都督。

translations.literal: Lujiao transferred command to Jinzhou to protect the works and was further made Left Chief Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao transferred to Jinzhou to protect the construction and was further made Left Chief Commander.

sentences.zh: 五月，大清兵圍錦州，率教與中官紀用、副將左輔、朱梅等嬰城固守。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Qing troops besieged Jinzhou; Lujiao, eunuch-official Ji Yong, and Vice Commanders Zuo Fu and Zhu Mei and others held the walls in desperate defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Qing troops besieged Jinzhou. Lujiao, eunuch-official Ji Yong, and Vice Commanders Zuo Fu and Zhu Mei held the walls in desperate defense.

sentences.zh: 發大炮，頗多擊傷。

translations.literal: Great cannon were fired and struck down very many.
translations.idiomatic: They fired great cannon and inflicted heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 相持二十四日，圍始解。

translations.literal: They held out for twenty-four days before the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: They held out for twenty-four days before the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 時桂亦著功寧遠，因稱「寧、錦大捷」。

translations.literal: At that time Gui also had merit at Ningyuan, and therefore it was called the "Great Victory of Ning and Jin."
translations.idiomatic: Gui also distinguished himself at Ningyuan, and the court called it the "Great Victory of Ning and Jin."

sentences.zh: 魏忠賢等蒙重賞。

translations.literal: Wei Zhongxian and others received heavy rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhongxian and others received heavy rewards.

sentences.zh: 率教加太子少傅，蔭錦衣千戶，世襲。

translations.literal: Lujiao was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, with hereditary enfeoffment as chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with a hereditary chiliarch enfeoffment in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年八月移鎮永平，兼轄薊鎮八路。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Chongzhen he transferred command to Yongping and concurrently governed the eight routes of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Chongzhen 1 he transferred to Yongping and concurrently governed the eight routes of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 逾月，掛平遼將軍印，再移至關門。

translations.literal: After a month he took the seal of Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong and moved again to Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: A month later he took the seal of Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong and moved again to Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 明年，大清兵由大安口南下。

translations.literal: The next year Qing troops came south through Daankou.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Qing troops came south through Daankou.

sentences.zh: 率教馳援，三晝夜抵三屯營。

translations.literal: Lujiao raced to the relief and reached Santun Camp in three days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: Lujiao raced to the relief and reached Santun Camp in three days and nights.

sentences.zh: 總兵朱國彥不令入，遂策馬而西。

translations.literal: Regional commander Zhu Guoyan would not let him enter, so he spurred his horse westward.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Zhu Guoyan would not let him enter, so he spurred his horse westward.

sentences.zh: 十一月四日戰於遵化，中流矢陣亡，一軍盡歿。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the eleventh month he fought at Zunhua, was struck by a stray arrow and died on the field, and his whole army perished.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the eleventh month he fought at Zunhua, was struck by a stray arrow and fell, and his whole army was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 帝聞痛悼，賜恤典，立祠奉祀。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, he grieved deeply, granted posthumous favors, and ordered a shrine built for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard, he grieved deeply, granted posthumous honors, and ordered a shrine built in his honor.

sentences.zh: 率教為將廉勇，待士有恩，勤身奉公，勞而不懈，與滿桂並稱良將。

translations.literal: As a general Lujiao was incorruptible and brave, treated his officers with kindness, devoted himself to public service and toiled without slackening; together with Man Gui he was called a good general.
translations.idiomatic: As a general Lujiao was incorruptible and brave, treated his officers with kindness, and toiled tirelessly for the state. Together with Man Gui he was counted among the best generals.

sentences.zh: 二人既歿，益無能辦東事者。

translations.literal: After the two men died, there was even less anyone able to manage eastern affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After they died, there was even less anyone capable of managing affairs in the east.

sentences.zh: 國彥以崇禎二年四月為薊鎮中協總兵官，駐三屯營。

translations.literal: Guoyan became regional commander of the central command of Jizhou in the fourth month of the second year of Chongzhen and was stationed at Santun Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Guoyan became regional commander of Jizhou's central command in the fourth month of Chongzhen 2 and was stationed at Santun Camp.

sentences.zh: 十一月六日，大清兵臨城，副將朱來同等挈家潛遁。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the eleventh month Qing troops reached the city; Vice Commander Zhu Laizhong and others took their families and fled in secret.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the eleventh month Qing troops reached the city. Vice Commander Zhu Laizhong and others fled in secret with their families.

sentences.zh: 國彥憤，榜諸人性名於通衢。

translations.literal: Guoyan was enraged and posted all their names on the public thoroughfare.
translations.idiomatic: Guoyan was enraged and posted all their names in the public square.

sentences.zh: 以所積俸銀五百余、衣服器具盡給部卒。

translations.literal: He gave all his accumulated salary of more than five hundred taels, clothing, and utensils to the troops under his command.
translations.idiomatic: He gave all his accumulated salary of more than five hundred taels, clothing, and equipment to his troops.

sentences.zh: 具冠帶西向稽首，偕妻張氏投繯死。

translations.literal: He put on cap and belt, bowed in prostration facing west, and together with his wife Lady Zhang hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: He put on his official regalia, bowed toward the west, and hanged himself together with his wife Lady Zhang.

sentences.zh: 官惟賢，萬歷未，為甘肅裴家營守備。

translations.literal: Guan Weixian, late in Wanli, served as garrison commander at Peijia Camp in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Wanli reign Guan Weixian served as garrison commander at Peijia Camp in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年以都司僉書署鎮番參將事，歷宣府遊擊、延綏西路參將，仍移鎮番。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi he served as secretary of a battalion command and acted as assistant commander at Zhenfan; he passed through the posts of roaming-brigade commander at Xuanfu and assistant commander on the western route of Yan'an and Suide, then returned to Zhenfan.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi 2 he acted as assistant commander at Zhenfan, then served as roaming-brigade commander at Xuanfu and assistant commander on the western Yan'an-Suide route before returning to Zhenfan.

sentences.zh: 五年春，河套、松山諸部入犯，惟賢偕參將丁孟科大敗之，斬首二百四十余級。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year the tribes of the Ordos and Songshan invaded; Weixian together with Assistant Commander Ding Mengke inflicted a great defeat and took more than two hundred forty heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year five the Ordos and Songshan tribes invaded. Weixian and Assistant Commander Ding Mengke inflicted a great defeat and took more than two hundred forty heads.

sentences.zh: 明年春，班記刺麻臺吉復糾松山銀定、歹成及矮木素、三兒臺吉，以三千騎來犯。

translations.literal: The next spring the Taji Banjici assembled Yinding and Daicheng of Songshan and the Tajis Aimusu and San'er with three thousand horsemen to invade.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring the Taji Banjici assembled Yinding and Daicheng of Songshan and the Tajis Aimusu and San'er with three thousand horsemen to invade.

sentences.zh: 惟賢再敗之，獲首功二百有奇。

translations.literal: Weixian defeated them again and took more than two hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian defeated them again and took more than two hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 三兒臺吉被創死。

translations.literal: The Taji San'er was wounded and died.
translations.idiomatic: The Taji San'er was wounded and died.

sentences.zh: 進惟賢副總兵。

translations.literal: Weixian was promoted to vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian was promoted to vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 其冬，銀定等以三兒之死挾憤圖報，益糾河套土巴臺吉等分道入掠。

translations.literal: That winter Yinding and the others, nursing anger over San'er's death and seeking revenge, further assembled the Ordos Taji Tubai and others to enter and plunder by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Yinding and the others, nursing anger over San'er's death, assembled the Ordos Taji Tubai and others to raid along separate routes.

sentences.zh: 惟賢及鎮將徐永壽等亦分道拒之，共獲首功百有六十。

translations.literal: Weixian and frontier commander Xu Yongshou and others also resisted them by separate routes and together took more than one hundred sixty heads.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian and frontier commander Xu Yongshou and others resisted them along separate routes and together took more than one hundred sixty heads.

sentences.zh: 七年春，銀定、賓兔、矮木素、班記刺麻合土賣火力赤等由黑水河入。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year Yinding, Bintu, Aimusu, Banjici, Hetumai, Huolichi, and others entered by the Heishui River.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year seven Yinding, Bintu, Aimusu, Banjici, Hetumai, Huolichi, and others entered by the Heishui River.

sentences.zh: 惟賢及西路副將陳洪範大破之，斬首百八十余級。

translations.literal: Weixian and Western Route Vice Commander Chen Hongfan inflicted a great defeat and beheaded more than one hundred eighty men.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian and Western Route Vice Commander Chen Hongfan inflicted a great defeat and beheaded more than one hundred eighty men.

sentences.zh: 當是時，西部頻寇邊，惟賢屢挫其鋒。

translations.literal: At that time the western tribes frequently raided the frontier, and Weixian repeatedly blunted their edge.
translations.idiomatic: At that time western tribes frequently raided the frontier, and Weixian repeatedly blunted their attacks.

sentences.zh: 其秋，王之臣督師遼東，乞惟賢赴關門。

translations.literal: That autumn Wang Zhichen supervised Liaodong and asked that Weixian come to Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Wang Zhichen supervised Liaodong and asked that Weixian come to Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 明年，崇禎改元，惟賢至，用為山海北路副總兵。

translations.literal: The next year, with the change of reign title to Chongzhen, Weixian arrived and was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the northern route of Shanhai.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, with the new Chongzhen reign, Weixian arrived and was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the northern Shanhai route.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，京師有警。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year the capital was alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year two the capital came under threat.

sentences.zh: 惟賢入衛，總理馬世龍令急援寶坻、漷縣。

translations.literal: Weixian entered to guard the capital; supreme commander Ma Shilong ordered him to hurry to the relief of Baodi and Huaxian.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian entered to guard the capital. Supreme commander Ma Shilong ordered him to hurry to the relief of Baodi and Huaxian.

sentences.zh: 明年正月九日，大清兵自撫寧向山海。

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the first month of the following year Qing troops moved from Funing toward Shanhai.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day of the first month of the following year Qing troops moved from Funing toward Shanhai.

sentences.zh: 翼日，至鳳凰店，離關三十里列三營。

translations.literal: The next day they reached Fenghuang Post, thirty li from the pass, and set up three camps.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they reached Fenghuang Post, thirty li from the pass, and set up three camps.

sentences.zh: 惟賢與參將陳維翰等設兩營以待，合戰，互有殺傷。

translations.literal: Weixian and Assistant Commander Chen Weihan and others set up two camps to wait; they joined battle and each side inflicted killing and wounding.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian and Assistant Commander Chen Weihan set up two camps to meet them. They joined battle and each side inflicted casualties.

sentences.zh: 已，大清兵返撫寧，世龍令惟賢率維翰及遊擊張奇化、李居正、王世選、王成等往襲遵化。

translations.literal: Presently Qing troops returned to Funing; Shilong ordered Weixian to lead Weihan and roaming-brigade commanders Zhang Qihua, Li Juzheng, Wang Shixuan, Wang Cheng, and others to strike Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: When Qing troops returned to Funing, Shilong ordered Weixian to lead Weihan and roaming-brigade commanders Zhang Qihua, Li Juzheng, Wang Shixuan, and Wang Cheng to strike Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 至城西波羅灣，城中兵出擊，前鋒殊死戰。

translations.literal: When they reached Boluo Bay west of the city, troops in the city came out to attack and the vanguard fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: At Boluo Bay west of the city the garrison came out to attack and the vanguard fought desperately.

sentences.zh: 大清兵收入城，後隊乘勢進攻，城上矢石如雨。

translations.literal: Qing troops withdrew into the city; the rear ranks pressed the attack with momentum, and arrows and stones rained from the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Qing troops withdrew into the city. The rear ranks pressed the attack, and arrows and stones rained from the walls.

sentences.zh: 尋復遣兵出戰，惟賢陷陣，中箭死，士卒殺傷者三百余人，奇化亦戰歿。

translations.literal: Soon they sent troops out to fight again; Weixian fell in the breach, was struck by an arrow and died, more than three hundred soldiers were killed and wounded, and Qihua also died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they sent troops out again. Weixian fell in the breach, was struck by an arrow and died, more than three hundred soldiers were killed or wounded, and Qihua also fell.

sentences.zh: 何可綱，遼東人。

translations.literal: He Kegang was a native of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: He Kegang was from Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 天啟中，以守備典袁崇煥寧遠道中軍，廉勇善撫士卒。

translations.literal: During Tianqi, as garrison commander he directed Yuan Chonghuan's central army on the Ningyuan route; he was incorruptible and brave and good at comforting the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianqi reign, as garrison commander he directed Yuan Chonghuan's central army on the Ningyuan route. He was incorruptible and brave and treated his soldiers well.

sentences.zh: 六年，寧遠被圍，佐崇煥捍禦有功，進都司僉書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when Ningyuan was besieged, he assisted Chonghuan in defense with merit and was advanced to secretary of a battalion command.
translations.idiomatic: In year six, when Ningyuan was besieged, he assisted Chonghuan in the defense with merit and was advanced to battalion secretary.

sentences.zh: 明年再被兵，復堅守。

translations.literal: The next year the city came under attack again, and he again held firm.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the city came under attack again, and he held firm once more.

sentences.zh: 遷參將，署寧遠副將事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to assistant commander and acted as vice commander at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to assistant commander and acted as vice commander at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年，巡撫畢自肅令典中軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongzhen Grand Coordinator Bi Zisu ordered him to direct the central army.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 1 Grand Coordinator Bi Zisu ordered him to direct the central army.

sentences.zh: 及崇煥再出鎮，復以副將領中軍事，靖十三營之變。

translations.literal: When Chonghuan again went out to command, he was again made vice commander in charge of central-army affairs and pacified the mutiny of the thirteen battalions.
translations.idiomatic: When Chonghuan returned to command, he again led the central army as vice commander and pacified the mutiny of the thirteen battalions.

sentences.zh: 崇煥欲更置大將，上言：「臣昔為巡撫，定議關外止設一總兵。

translations.literal: Chonghuan wished to reorganize the great generals and memorialized, "When I was grand coordinator I fixed the policy that beyond the pass only one regional commander should be set."
translations.idiomatic: Chonghuan wished to reorganize the senior commanders and memorialized, "When I was grand coordinator I fixed the policy that only one regional commander should be posted beyond the pass."

sentences.zh: 其時魏忠賢竊柄，崔呈秀欲用其私黨，增設三四人，以致權勢相衡，臂指不運。

translations.literal: At that time Wei Zhongxian usurped power; Cui Chengxiu wished to use his private faction and added three or four men, so that authority balanced against authority and arm and finger did not move together.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wei Zhongxian usurped power. Cui Chengxiu wished to install his own faction and added three or four commanders, so that authority was divided and command would not move as one.

sentences.zh: 乃止留寧遠及前鋒二人，而臂指之不運猶故也。

translations.literal: They then kept only two men at Ningyuan and the vanguard, yet arm and finger still did not move together as before.
translations.idiomatic: They then kept only two commanders at Ningyuan and the vanguard, yet command still did not move as one.

sentences.zh: 臣以為寧遠一路，斷宜並歸前鋒。

translations.literal: Your servant holds that the Ningyuan route should certainly be merged under the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that the Ningyuan route should be merged under the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 總兵駐關內者，掛平遼將軍印，轄山、石二路，而以前屯隸之。

translations.literal: The regional commander stationed inside the pass should bear the seal of Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong, govern the Shanhai and Shitang routes, and have Qiantun subordinated to him.
translations.idiomatic: The regional commander inside the pass should bear the seal of Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong, govern the Shanhai and Shitang routes, and have Qiantun subordinated to him.

sentences.zh: 駐關外者，掛征遼前鋒將軍印，轄寧遠一衛，而以錦州隸之。

translations.literal: The one stationed outside the pass should bear the seal of Vanguard General for the Liaodong Campaign, govern the one guard of Ningyuan, and have Jinzhou subordinated to him.
translations.idiomatic: The commander outside the pass should bear the seal of Vanguard General for the Liaodong Campaign, govern Ningyuan Guard, and have Jinzhou subordinated to him.

sentences.zh: 薊遼總兵趙率教久習遼事，宜與山海麻登雲相易，掛平遼將軍印。

translations.literal: Jizhou-Liaodong regional commander Zhao Lujiao has long been versed in Liaodong affairs and should exchange posts with Ma Dengyun of Shanhai, bearing the seal of Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou-Liaodong regional commander Zhao Lujiao, long versed in Liaodong affairs, should exchange posts with Ma Dengyun of Shanhai and bear the seal of Pacification Commissioner of Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 關外總兵舊有朱梅、祖大壽。

translations.literal: Beyond the pass there had formerly been regional commanders Zhu Mei and Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the pass there had formerly been regional commanders Zhu Mei and Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 梅已解任，宜並歸大壽，駐錦州，而以臣中軍何可綱專防寧遠。

translations.literal: Mei has already left office; both should be merged under Dashou, stationed at Jinzhou, while my central-army officer He Kegang should be put solely in charge of defending Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Mei has already left office. Both posts should be merged under Dashou at Jinzhou, while my central-army officer He Kegang should defend Ningyuan alone.

sentences.zh: 可綱仁而有勇，廉而能勤，事至善謀，其才不在臣下。

translations.literal: Kegang is benevolent yet brave, incorruptible yet diligent, plans matters to the finest point, and his talent is not below mine.
translations.idiomatic: Kegang is benevolent yet brave, incorruptible yet diligent, plans with great care, and his talent is not below mine.

sentences.zh: 臣向所建豎，實可綱力，請加都督僉事，仍典臣中軍。

translations.literal: What your servant has built up was in truth Kegang's strength; I ask that he be made Vice Commissioner-in-chief and still direct my central army.
translations.idiomatic: What I have built up was in truth Kegang's doing. I ask that he be made Vice Commissioner and still direct my central army.

sentences.zh: 則一鎮之費雖裁，一鎮之用仍在。

translations.literal: Then though the expense of one command post is cut, the utility of one command post remains.
translations.idiomatic: Then though the expense of one command post is cut, its effectiveness remains.

sentences.zh: 臣妄謂五年奏凱者，仗此三人之力，用而不效，請治臣罪。

translations.literal: Your servant presumptuously says that victory reported in five years will depend on the strength of these three men; if they are used without effect, I ask that I be punished.
translations.idiomatic: I venture to say that victory within five years will depend on these three men. If they are used without effect, punish me.

sentences.zh: 」帝悉從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved all of it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 可綱佐崇煥更定軍制，歲省餉百二十萬有奇。

translations.literal: Kegang assisted Chonghuan in reforming the military system and saved more than 1.2 million taels in pay each year.
translations.idiomatic: Kegang assisted Chonghuan in reforming the military system and saved more than 1.2 million taels in pay each year.

sentences.zh: 以春秋二防功，進職右都督。

translations.literal: For merit in the spring and autumn defenses he was advanced to Right Chief Commander.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in the spring and autumn defenses he was advanced to Right Chief Commander.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，京師被兵，與大壽從崇煥入衛，數有功。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year, when the capital came under attack, he followed Dashou with Chonghuan to guard the capital and achieved merit several times.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year two, when the capital came under attack, he followed Dashou with Chonghuan to guard the capital and distinguished himself several times.

sentences.zh: 崇煥下吏，乃隨大壽東潰，復與歸朝。

translations.literal: When Chonghuan was cast into prison he followed Dashou in the eastern collapse, then returned with him to court.
translations.idiomatic: When Chonghuan was imprisoned he followed Dashou in the eastern rout, then returned with him to court.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，永平、灤州失守，可綱戰古冶鄉及雙望，頗有斬獲。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year Yongping and Luanzhou fell; Kegang fought at Guye Township and Shuangwang and took considerable heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year Yongping and Luanzhou fell. Kegang fought at Guye Township and Shuangwang and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 四月，樞輔孫承宗令可綱督諸將營雙望諸山，以綴永平之師。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong ordered Kegang to supervise the generals in encamping on the mountains of Shuangwang to delay the Yongping army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong ordered Kegang to supervise the generals in encamping on the mountains around Shuangwang to delay the Yongping army.

sentences.zh: 令大壽諸軍直趨灤州。

translations.literal: He ordered Dashou's army to press straight toward Luanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Dashou's army to press straight toward Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 灤州既復，大清兵棄永平去，可綱遂入其城。

translations.literal: When Luanzhou was recovered, Qing troops abandoned Yongping and left; Kegang then entered that city.
translations.idiomatic: When Luanzhou was recovered, Qing troops abandoned Yongping and left. Kegang then entered the city.

sentences.zh: 論功，加太子太保、左都督。

translations.literal: When merit was discussed he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Left Chief Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was discussed he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Left Chief Commander.

sentences.zh: 已而錦州被圍，可綱督諸將赴救，立功郵馬山，復進秩。

translations.literal: Presently Jinzhou was besieged; Kegang supervised the generals in going to its relief, achieved merit at Youmashan, and was advanced in rank again.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jinzhou was besieged. Kegang supervised the generals in relief, distinguished himself at Youmashan, and was advanced in rank again.

sentences.zh: 四年築城大淩河，命可綱偕大壽護版築。

translations.literal: In the fourth year a city was built at Daling River; Kegang was ordered to join Dashou in protecting the construction.
translations.idiomatic: In year four a city was built at Daling River. Kegang was ordered to join Dashou in protecting the construction.

sentences.zh: 八月甫竣工，大清以十萬眾來攻，可綱等堅守不下。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, just as it was completed, the Great Qing came to attack with one hundred thousand men; Kegang and the others held firm and would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, just as construction was completed, the Qing attacked with one hundred thousand men. Kegang and the others held firm and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 久之，糧盡援絕。

translations.literal: After a long time grain was exhausted and relief cut off.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time grain ran out and relief was cut off.

sentences.zh: 大壽及諸將皆欲降，獨可綱不從，令二人掖出城外殺之，可綱顏色不變，亦不發一言，含笑而死。

translations.literal: Dashou and the other generals all wished to surrender; Kegang alone would not comply. He ordered two men to lead him out beyond the walls and kill him; Kegang's expression did not change, he spoke not a word, and died with a smile.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou and the other generals all wished to surrender. Kegang alone refused. He ordered two men to lead him outside the walls and kill him. His expression did not change, he spoke not a word, and died with a smile.

sentences.zh: 黃龍，遼東人。

translations.literal: Huang Long was a native of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Long was from Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 初以小校從復錦州，積功至參將。

translations.literal: At first as a petty officer he followed in the recovery of Jinzhou, and through accumulated merit rose to assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a petty officer in the recovery of Jinzhou and through accumulated merit rose to assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 崇禎三年從大軍復灤州，功第一，遷副總兵。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongzhen he followed the great army in recovering Luanzhou, took first place in merit, and was transferred to vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 3 he followed the main army in recovering Luanzhou, ranked first in merit, and was transferred to vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 尋論功進秩三等，為都督僉事，世蔭副千戶。

translations.literal: Soon merit was discussed and his rank was advanced three grades; he was made Vice Commissioner-in-chief with hereditary enfeoffment as vice chiliarch.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was discussed his rank was advanced three grades. He was made Vice Commissioner with a hereditary vice chiliarch enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 登萊巡撫孫元化以劉興治亂東江，請龍往鎮。

translations.literal: Dengzhou-Laizhou Grand Coordinator Sun Yuanhua, because Liu Xingzhi had thrown eastern Jiang into disorder, asked that Long go to command there.
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhou-Laizhou Grand Coordinator Sun Yuanhua, because Liu Xingzhi had thrown eastern Jiang into disorder, asked that Long go to command there.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書梁廷棟亦薦龍為總兵官，與元化恢復四衛，從之。

translations.literal: Minister of War Liang Tingdong also recommended Long as regional commander to recover the four guards together with Yuanhua, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Liang Tingdong also recommended Long as regional commander to recover the four guards with Yuanhua, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 先是，毛文龍死，袁崇煥分其兵二萬八千為四協，命副將陳繼盛，參將劉興治、毛承祚、徐敷奏主之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Mao Wenlong died, Yuan Chonghuan divided his twenty-eight thousand troops into four commands and appointed Vice Commander Chen Jisheng and Assistant Commanders Liu Xingzhi, Mao Chengzuo, and Xu Fuzou to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Mao Wenlong died, Yuan Chonghuan divided his twenty-eight thousand troops into four commands under Vice Commander Chen Jisheng and Assistant Commanders Liu Xingzhi, Mao Chengzuo, and Xu Fuzou.

sentences.zh: 後改為兩協，繼盛領東協，興治攝西協。

translations.literal: Later this was changed to two commands; Jisheng led the eastern command and Xingzhi acted for the western command.
translations.idiomatic: Later this was reduced to two commands. Jisheng led the eastern command and Xingzhi acted for the western command.

sentences.zh: 語詳《崇煥傳》。

translations.literal: The account is given in full in the "Biography of Chonghuan."
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in the Biography of Chonghuan.

sentences.zh: 興治兇狡好亂，與繼盛不相能。

translations.literal: Xingzhi was fierce, cunning, and fond of disorder and could not get along with Jisheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhi was fierce, cunning, and fond of disorder and could not get along with Jisheng.

sentences.zh: 其兄參將興祚陣亡，繼盛誤聽諜報，謂未死。

translations.literal: His elder brother Assistant Commander Xingzuo died on the field; Jisheng mistakenly believed a spy report that he was not dead.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Assistant Commander Xingzuo had died in battle, but Jisheng mistakenly believed a spy report that he was still alive.

sentences.zh: 興治憤，擇日為興祚治喪，諸將鹹吊。

translations.literal: Xingzhi was enraged, chose a day to hold mourning for Xingzuo, and all the generals came to condole.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhi was enraged. He chose a day to hold mourning for Xingzuo, and all the generals came to condole.

sentences.zh: 繼盛至，伏兵執之，並執理餉經歷劉應鶴等十一人。

translations.literal: When Jisheng arrived, ambush troops seized him and also seized grain-supply secretary Liu Yinghe and eleven others.
translations.idiomatic: When Jisheng arrived, ambush troops seized him along with grain-supply secretary Liu Yinghe and eleven others.

sentences.zh: 袖出一書，宣於眾，詭言此繼盛誣興祚詐死，及以謀叛誣陷己者，遂殺繼盛及應鶴等。

translations.literal: He drew out a document and proclaimed it to the assembly, falsely saying that this was Jisheng's slander that Xingzuo had feigned death and his framing of Xingzhi for plotting rebellion; he then killed Jisheng and Yinghe and the others.
translations.idiomatic: He produced a document and read it aloud, falsely claiming that Jisheng had slandered Xingzuo as feigning death and had framed him for rebellion. He then killed Jisheng, Yinghe, and the others.

sentences.zh: 又偽為島中商民奏一通，請優恤興祚，而令興治鎮東江。

translations.literal: He also forged a memorial in the name of merchants on the island, asking generous posthumous favors for Xingzuo and that Xingzhi be put in command of eastern Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: He also forged a memorial in the name of island merchants asking generous posthumous honors for Xingzuo and appointing Xingzhi to command eastern Jiang.

sentences.zh: 舉朝大駭，以海外未遑詰也。

translations.literal: The whole court was greatly alarmed, but because the matter was overseas there was no leisure to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The whole court was alarmed, but because the matter was overseas there was no time to investigate.

sentences.zh: 興冶與諸弟兄放舟長山島，大肆殺掠。

translations.literal: Xingzhi and his brothers launched boats to Changshan Island and carried out great killing and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhi and his brothers sailed to Changshan Island and carried out widespread killing and plunder.

sentences.zh: 島去登州四十里。

translations.literal: The island was forty li from Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The island lay forty li from Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 時登萊總兵官張可大赴援永平，帝用廷棟言，趣可大還登州，授副將周文郁大將印，令撫定興冶。

translations.literal: At that time Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander Zhang Kedai had gone to relieve Yongping; the emperor followed Tingdong's advice, urged Kedai back to Dengzhou, gave Vice Commander Zhou Wenyu the great general's seal, and ordered him to pacify Xingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander Zhang Kedai had gone to relieve Yongping. The emperor followed Tingdong's advice, ordered Kedai back to Dengzhou, gave Vice Commander Zhou Wenyu the great general's seal, and ordered him to pacify Xingzhi.

sentences.zh: 會永平已復，興治稍戢，返東江。

translations.literal: It happened that Yongping had already been recovered; Xingzhi grew somewhat restrained and returned to eastern Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping had already been recovered. Xingzhi grew somewhat restrained and returned to eastern Jiang.

sentences.zh: 龍蒞皮島受事，興治猶桀驁如故。

translations.literal: Long came to Pidao to take up his post, but Xingzhi remained arrogant and unruly as before.
translations.idiomatic: Long came to Pidao to take up his post, but Xingzhi remained as arrogant and unruly as before.

sentences.zh: 四年三月復作亂，杖其弟興基，殺參將沈世魁家眾。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year he rebelled again, beat his younger brother Xingji, and killed the household retainers of Assistant Commander Shen Shikui.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year four he rebelled again, beat his younger brother Xingji, and killed the household of Assistant Commander Shen Shikui.

sentences.zh: 世魁率其黨夜襲殺興治，亂乃定。

translations.literal: Shikui led his faction in a night attack and killed Xingzhi, and the disorder was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Shikui led his faction in a night attack and killed Xingzhi, ending the disorder.

sentences.zh: 遊擊耿仲明之黨李梅者，通洋事覺，龍系之獄。

translations.literal: Li Mei, a follower of roaming-brigade commander Geng Zhongming, was discovered in illicit overseas dealings and Long imprisoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mei, a follower of roaming-brigade commander Geng Zhongming, was caught in illicit overseas dealings and imprisoned by Long.

sentences.zh: 仲明弟都司仲裕在龍軍，謀作亂。

translations.literal: Zhongming's younger brother, battalion commander Zhongyu, was in Long's army and plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongming's younger brother, battalion commander Zhongyu, was in Long's army and plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 十月率部卒假索餉名圍龍署，擁至演武場，折股去耳鼻，將殺之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he led his troops under the pretext of demanding pay to surround Long's headquarters, dragged him to the drill ground, broke his thigh and cut off his ears and nose, and was about to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he led his troops under the pretext of demanding pay to surround Long's headquarters, dragged him to the drill ground, broke his thigh and cut off his ears and nose, and was about to kill him.

sentences.zh: 諸將為救免。

translations.literal: The generals rescued him and he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: The generals rescued him and spared his life.

sentences.zh: 未幾，龍捕斬仲裕，疏請正仲明罪。

translations.literal: Before long Long captured and beheaded Zhongyu and memorialized asking that Zhongming's crime be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Long captured and beheaded Zhongyu and memorialized asking that Zhongming be punished.

sentences.zh: 會元化劾龍克餉致兵嘩，帝命充為事官，而核仲明主使狀。

translations.literal: It happened that Yuanhua impeached Long for withholding pay and causing the troops to mutiny; the emperor ordered him to serve as an officer on probation while Zhongming's role as mastermind was investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhua impeached Long for withholding pay and causing a mutiny. The emperor ordered him to serve on probation while Zhongming's role as mastermind was investigated.

sentences.zh: 仲明遂偕孔有德反，以五年正月陷登州，招島中諸將。

translations.literal: Zhongming then rebelled together with Kong Youde; in the first month of the fifth year they took Dengzhou and summoned the generals on the islands.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongming then rebelled with Kong Youde. In the first month of year five they took Dengzhou and summoned the island generals.

sentences.zh: 旅順副將陳有時、廣鹿島副將毛承祿皆往從之。

translations.literal: Lüshun Vice Commander Chen Youshi and Guanglu Island Vice Commander Mao Chenglu both went to join them.
translations.idiomatic: Lüshun Vice Commander Chen Youshi and Guanglu Island Vice Commander Mao Chenglu both joined them.

sentences.zh: 龍急遣尚可喜、金聲桓等撫定諸島，而躬巡其地，慰商民，誅叛黨，縱火焚其舟。

translations.literal: Long urgently sent Shang Kexi, Jin Shenghuan, and others to pacify the islands, while he personally toured the area, comforted the merchants, executed rebel factions, and set fire to burn their boats.
translations.idiomatic: Long urgently sent Shang Kexi, Jin Shenghuan, and others to pacify the islands while he personally toured the area, comforted merchants, executed rebels, and burned their boats.

sentences.zh: 賊黨高成友者據旅順，斷關寧、天津援師。

translations.literal: The rebel Gao Chengyou held Lüshun and cut off relief armies from Shanhaiguan, Ningyuan, and Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Gao Chengyou held Lüshun and cut off relief from Shanhaiguan, Ningyuan, and Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 龍令遊擊李維鸞偕可喜等擊走之，即移駐其地，援始通。

translations.literal: Long ordered roaming-brigade commander Li Weiluan together with Kexi and others to strike and drive him off, then moved his headquarters there, and relief was at last restored.
translations.idiomatic: Long ordered roaming-brigade commander Li Weiluan with Kexi and others to drive him off, then moved his headquarters there, and relief was restored.

sentences.zh: 其冬，有德等欲棄登州走入海，龍遣副將龔正祥率舟師四千邀之廟島。

translations.literal: That winter Youde and the others wished to abandon Dengzhou and flee by sea; Long sent Vice Commander Gong Zhengxiang with four thousand naval troops to intercept them at Miaodao.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Youde and the others wished to abandon Dengzhou and flee by sea. Long sent Vice Commander Gong Zhengxiang with four thousand naval troops to intercept them at Miaodao.

sentences.zh: 颶風破舟，正祥陷賊中。

translations.literal: A typhoon wrecked the boats and Zhengxiang fell into the rebels' hands.
translations.idiomatic: A typhoon wrecked the boats and Zhengxiang fell into rebel hands.

sentences.zh: 後居登州，謀為內應，事露被殺。

translations.literal: Later he lived in Dengzhou and plotted to serve as an inside agent; when the matter was exposed he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Later he lived in Dengzhou and plotted to serve as an inside agent. When the plot was exposed he was killed.

sentences.zh: 初，龍駐旅順大治兵。

translations.literal: At first Long was stationed at Lüshun and greatly trained the army.
translations.idiomatic: At first Long was stationed at Lüshun and greatly expanded the army.

sentences.zh: 賊拘龍母妻及子以脅之，龍不顧。

translations.literal: The rebels seized Long's mother, wife, and son to threaten him, but Long paid no heed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels seized Long's mother, wife, and son to threaten him, but Long paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，有德、仲明屢為巡撫朱大典所敗，航海遁去。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year Youde and Zhongming were repeatedly defeated by Grand Coordinator Zhu Dadian and fled by sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year six Youde and Zhongming were repeatedly defeated by Grand Coordinator Zhu Dadian and fled by sea.

sentences.zh: 龍度有德等必遁，遁必經旅順，邀擊之。

translations.literal: Long judged that Youde and the others would certainly flee, that flight would certainly pass Lüshun, and intercepted them.
translations.idiomatic: Long judged that Youde would flee by sea and must pass Lüshun, and intercepted them.

sentences.zh: 有德幾獲而逸。

translations.literal: Youde was nearly captured but escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Youde was nearly captured but escaped.

sentences.zh: 斬賊魁李九成子應元，生擒毛承祿、蘇有功、陳光福及其黨高誌祥等十六人，獲首級一千有奇，奪還婦女無算，獻俘於朝。

translations.literal: He beheaded the rebel leader Li Jiucheng's son Yingyuan, captured alive Mao Chenglu, Su Yougong, Chen Guangfu, and their follower Gao Zhixiang and sixteen others, took more than one thousand heads, recovered countless women, and presented captives at court.
translations.idiomatic: He beheaded the rebel leader Li Jiucheng's son Yingyuan, captured Mao Chenglu, Su Yougong, Chen Guangfu, Gao Zhixiang, and sixteen others alive, took more than one thousand heads, recovered countless women, and presented captives at court.

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，磔承祿等，傳首九邊，復龍官。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased, dismembered Chenglu and the others, sent their heads through the nine border regions, and restored Long to office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased, dismembered Chenglu and the others, sent their heads through the nine border regions, and restored Long to office.

sentences.zh: 承祿，文龍族家子也。

translations.literal: Chenglu was a clansman of Wenlong's family.
translations.idiomatic: Chenglu was a kinsman of Wenlong's clan.

sentences.zh: 有德等大憤，欲報龍。

translations.literal: Youde and the others were greatly enraged and wished to take revenge on Long.
translations.idiomatic: Youde and the others were enraged and sought revenge on Long.

sentences.zh: 會賊舟泊鴨綠江，龍盡發水師剿之。

translations.literal: It happened that rebel boats anchored on the Yalu River; Long sent out the entire navy to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel boats anchored on the Yalu River, and Long sent out the entire navy against them.

sentences.zh: 七月，有德等偵知旅順空虛，遂引大清兵來襲。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Youde and the others learned by reconnaissance that Lüshun was empty and then led Qing troops to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Youde learned that Lüshun was undefended and led Qing troops to attack.

sentences.zh: 龍數戰皆敗，火藥矢石俱盡，語部將譚應華曰：「敵眾我寡，今夕城必破。

translations.literal: Long fought several battles and was defeated each time; gunpowder, arrows, and stones were all exhausted. He said to Vice Commander Tan Yinghua, "The enemy are many and we few—the city will certainly fall tonight."
translations.idiomatic: Long fought several battles and lost each time. Gunpowder, arrows, and stones were exhausted. He told Vice Commander Tan Yinghua, "The enemy outnumber us. The city will fall tonight."

sentences.zh: 若速持吾印送登州，不能赴，即投諸海可也。

translations.literal: If you quickly take my seal to Dengzhou, and if you cannot go, cast it into the sea."
translations.idiomatic: Take my seal quickly to Dengzhou. If you cannot reach it, cast it into the sea."

sentences.zh: 」應華出，龍率惟鸞等力戰。

translations.literal: " Yinghua went out, and Long led Weiluan and the others in fierce fighting.
translations.idiomatic: " Yinghua went out, and Long led Weiluan and the others in fierce fighting.

sentences.zh: 圍急，知不能脫，自剄死。

translations.literal: The encirclement grew desperate; knowing he could not escape, he cut his own throat and died.
translations.idiomatic: The encirclement tightened. Knowing he could not escape, he cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 惟鸞及諸將項祚臨、樊化龍、張大祿、尚可義俱死之。

translations.literal: Weiluan and the generals Xiang Zuolin, Fan Hualong, Zhang Dalu, and Shang Keyi all died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Weiluan and the generals Xiang Zuolin, Fan Hualong, Zhang Dalu, and Shang Keyi all died with him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈龍左都督，賜祭葬，予世蔭，建祠曰：「顯忠」。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Long was posthumously granted Left Chief Commander, given sacrificial rites and burial honors, granted hereditary enfeoffment, and a shrine was built called "Manifest Loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached court, Long was posthumously made Left Chief Commander, granted sacrificial rites and state burial and hereditary enfeoffment, and a shrine called "Manifest Loyalty" was built in his honor.

sentences.zh: 惟鸞等附祀。

translations.literal: Weiluan and the others received attendant sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Weiluan and the others received attendant sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 以副總兵沈世魁代龍為總兵官。

translations.literal: Vice Commander-in-chief Shen Shikui was appointed regional commander in Long's place.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Shen Shikui replaced Long as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 世魁本市儈，其女有殊色，為毛文龍小妻。

translations.literal: Shikui had originally been a market broker; his daughter was of rare beauty and became Mao Wenlong's junior wife.
translations.idiomatic: Shikui had originally been a market broker. His daughter was exceptionally beautiful and became Mao Wenlong's junior wife.

sentences.zh: 世魁倚勢橫行島中，至是為大帥。

translations.literal: Shikui relied on his power and acted tyrannically on the island; by this time he was supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: Shikui relied on his power and acted tyrannically on the island. By then he was supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，廣鹿島副將尚可喜降於我大清，島中勢益孤。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year Guanglu Island Vice Commander Shang Kexi surrendered to Our Great Qing, and the position on the islands grew even more isolated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year seven Guanglu Island Vice Commander Shang Kexi surrendered to the Qing, and the island forces grew even more isolated.

sentences.zh: 十年，朝鮮告急，世魁移師皮島為聲援。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Korea reported emergency; Shikui moved his army to Pidao as a supporting threat.
translations.idiomatic: In year ten Korea reported an emergency. Shikui moved his army to Pidao as a supporting force.

sentences.zh: 有德等來襲，世魁戰敗，率舟師走石城，副將金日觀陣歿。

translations.literal: Youde and the others came to attack; Shikui was defeated in battle, led the navy in flight to Shicheng, and Vice Commander Jin Riguan died on the field.
translations.idiomatic: Youde and the others attacked. Shikui was beaten, fled by sea to Shicheng, and Vice Commander Jin Riguan fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 登萊總兵陳洪範來援，不戰而走。

translations.literal: Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander Chen Hongfan came to the relief but fled without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander Chen Hongfan came to relieve them but fled without fighting.

sentences.zh: 世魁亦陣亡，士卒死傷者萬余。

translations.literal: Shikui also died on the field, and more than ten thousand soldiers were killed and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Shikui also fell in battle, and more than ten thousand soldiers were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 從子副將誌科集潰卒至長城島，欲得世魁敕印。

translations.literal: His nephew Vice Commander Zhike gathered routed troops at Changcheng Island and wished to obtain Shikui's imperial commission and seal.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Vice Commander Zhike gathered routed troops at Changcheng Island and tried to seize Shikui's commission and seal.

sentences.zh: 監軍副使黃孫茂不予，誌科怒殺之，並殺理餉通判邵啟。

translations.literal: Supervising Vice Commissioner Huang Sunmao would not give them; Zhike killed him in anger and also killed grain-supply vice prefect Shao Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Vice Commissioner Huang Sunmao refused. Zhike killed him in anger and also killed grain-supply vice prefect Shao Qi.

sentences.zh: 副將白登庸遂率所部降大清。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Bai Dengyong then led his troops to surrender to the Great Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Bai Dengyong then led his troops to surrender to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 諸島雖有殘卒，不能成軍，朝廷亦不置大帥，以登萊總兵遙領之而已。

translations.literal: Though the islands still had scattered troops, they could not form an army; the court also did not appoint a supreme commander and merely had the Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander govern them from afar.
translations.idiomatic: The islands still had scattered troops but could not form an army. The court appointed no supreme commander and merely had the Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander govern them from afar.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，楊嗣昌決策盡徙其兵民寧、錦，而諸島一空。

translations.literal: The next summer Yang Sichang decided to move all their troops and civilians to Ningyuan and Jinzhou, and the islands were left empty.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer Yang Sichang decided to move all troops and civilians to Ningyuan and Jinzhou, and the islands were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 金日觀，不知何許人。

translations.literal: Jin Riguan—his origin is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Riguan was of unknown origin.

sentences.zh: 天啟五年以將才授守備，效力關門。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianqi, for military talent he was appointed garrison commander and served at Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi 5, for military talent he was appointed garrison commander and served at Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 擢鎮標中軍遊擊，加參將行薊鎮東路遊擊事，專領南兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted to roaming-brigade commander of the garrison standard central army, given the added post of assistant commander acting as roaming-brigade commander on the eastern route of Jizhou, and put solely in charge of southern troops.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to roaming-brigade commander of the garrison standard central army, appointed acting assistant commander on Jizhou's eastern route, and put in charge of southern troops.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，加副總兵，守馬蘭峪。

translations.literal: Early in Chongzhen he was made vice commander-in-chief and defended Malanyu.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongzhen reign he was made vice commander-in-chief and defended Malanyu.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，大清兵破京東列城。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Qing troops broke the walled cities east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year three Qing troops broke the walled cities east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎劉之綸遣部將吳應龍等結營毛山，規取羅文谷關。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Liu Zhilun sent subordinate generals Wu Yinglong and others to encamp at Maoshan, planning to take Luowengu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of War Liu Zhilun sent subordinate generals Wu Yinglong and others to encamp at Maoshan, planning to take Luowengu Pass.

sentences.zh: 師敗，日觀遣二將馳援，亦敗歿。

translations.literal: The army was defeated; Riguan sent two generals in haste to the relief, and they too were defeated and perished.
translations.idiomatic: The army was defeated. Riguan sent two generals to the relief, and they too were defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 大清兵乘勝據府君、玉皇二山，進攻馬蘭城甚急。

translations.literal: Qing troops pressed their victory to hold Mount Fujun and Mount Yuhuang and attacked Malan city with great urgency.
translations.idiomatic: Qing troops pressed their victory, seized Mount Fujun and Mount Yuhuang, and attacked Malan city fiercely.

sentences.zh: 日觀堅守，親然大炮。

translations.literal: Riguan held firm and personally loaded the great cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Riguan held firm and personally loaded the great cannon.

sentences.zh: 炮炸，焚頭目手足，意氣不衰。

translations.literal: The cannon exploded, burning his head, eyes, hands, and feet, yet his spirit did not flag.
translations.idiomatic: The cannon exploded, burning his head, eyes, hands, and feet, yet his spirit did not flag.

sentences.zh: 乞援於總理馬世龍。

translations.literal: He begged relief from supreme commander Ma Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: He begged relief from supreme commander Ma Shilong.

sentences.zh: 令參將王世選等赴救，兵乃退。

translations.literal: He ordered Assistant Commander Wang Shixuan and others to go to the relief, and the enemy troops then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Ma ordered Assistant Commander Wang Shixuan and others to the relief, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 尋復以二千余騎來攻，日觀偕世選等死守不下。

translations.literal: Soon more than two thousand horsemen came to attack again; Riguan together with Shixuan and the others defended to the death and would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: Soon more than two thousand horsemen attacked again. Riguan with Shixuan and the others held firm and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 朝廷獎其功，驟加都督同知。

translations.literal: The court rewarded his merit and abruptly promoted him to Vice Commissioner-in-chief of the Chief Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The court rewarded his merit and abruptly promoted him to Vice Commissioner of the Chief Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 四月，與副將謝尚政、曹文詔等攻復大安城，遂偕諸軍復遵化。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, together with Vice Commanders Xie Shangzheng, Cao Wenshao, and others, he attacked and recovered Da'an city, then joined the armies in recovering Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he with Vice Commanders Xie Shangzheng, Cao Wenshao, and others recovered Da'an city, then joined the armies in recovering Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 錄功，進左都督。

translations.literal: When merit was recorded he was advanced to Left Chief Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was recorded he was advanced to Left Chief Commander.

sentences.zh: 時總兵鄧玘轄馬蘭、松棚二路，日觀應受節制。

translations.literal: At that time regional commander Deng Qi governed the Malan and Songpeng routes, and Riguan should have been under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Deng Qi then governed the Malan and Songpeng routes, and Riguan should have been under his command.

sentences.zh: 以玘銜都督同知，不屑為之下。

translations.literal: Because Qi bore the rank of Vice Commissioner-in-chief of the Chief Military Commission, Riguan disdained to be subordinate to him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Qi held the rank of Vice Commissioner, Riguan disdained to serve under him.

sentences.zh: 總督曹文衡劾日觀器小易盈，恃功驕縱，帝特戒飭而已。

translations.literal: Governor-in-chief Cao Wenheng impeached Riguan as small-minded and easily filled, arrogant and unrestrained in relying on his merit; the emperor merely issued a special admonition.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-in-chief Cao Wenheng impeached Riguan as small-minded, arrogant, and unrestrained in relying on his merit. The emperor merely issued a special admonition.

sentences.zh: 久之，移萊州副總兵。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to vice commander-in-chief at Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was transferred to vice commander-in-chief at Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 十年春，大清兵攻朝鮮，命從登萊總兵陳洪範往救，駐師皮島。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year Qing troops attacked Korea; he was ordered to follow Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander Chen Hongfan to the relief and stationed his army at Pidao.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year ten Qing troops attacked Korea. He was ordered to follow Dengzhou-Laizhou regional commander Chen Hongfan to the relief and stationed at Pidao.

sentences.zh: 大清遣孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜等先攻鐵山。

translations.literal: The Great Qing sent Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, and others first to attack Tieshan.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing sent Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, and others first to attack Tieshan.

sentences.zh: 四月分兵攻皮島，水陸夾攻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month they divided forces to attack Pidao, striking by land and water together.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month they divided forces to attack Pidao by land and sea together.

sentences.zh: 副將白登庸先遁，洪範亦避走石城。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Bai Dengyong fled first, and Hongfan also avoided battle and fled to Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Bai Dengyong fled first, and Hongfan also fled to Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 登庸尋帥所部降。

translations.literal: Dengyong soon led his troops to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Dengyong soon led his troops to surrender.

sentences.zh: 日觀偕諸將楚繼功等相持七晝夜，力不支，陣歿，島城隨破。

translations.literal: Riguan together with the generals Chu Jigong and others held out for seven days and nights; their strength failed, he died on the field, and the island city fell immediately after.
translations.idiomatic: Riguan with the generals Chu Jigong and others held out for seven days and nights. When their strength failed he fell in battle and the island city fell.

sentences.zh: 贈特進光祿大夫、太子太師，世蔭錦衣副千戶，建祠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Special Advancement Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, with hereditary enfeoffment as vice chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and a shrine was built.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Special Advancement Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, granted a hereditary vice chiliarch enfeoffment in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and given a shrine.

sentences.zh: 繼功等贈恤有差。

translations.literal: Jigong and the others received posthumous favors in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Jigong and the others received posthumous honors in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：古人有言，彼且為我死，故我得與之俱生。

translations.literal: The commentator says: The ancients had a saying—because they were willing to die for me, I was able to live together with them.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: The ancients had a saying—because they were willing to die for me, I was able to live on with them.

sentences.zh: 故死封疆之臣，君子重之。

translations.literal: Therefore ministers who died for the frontier, the noble person esteems them.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the noble person esteems those who died defending the frontier.

sentences.zh: 觀遼左諸帥，委身許國，見危不避，可謂得死所者與！

translations.literal: Observing the generals of eastern Liaodong, they devoted their persons to the state, did not avoid danger when they saw it, and may be said to have found the right place to die!
translations.idiomatic: Looking at the generals of eastern Liaodong, they devoted themselves to the state and did not shrink from danger. They may be said to have found the right place to die!

sentences.zh: 於時優恤之典非不甚渥，然而無救於危亡者，廟算不定，僨事者不誅，文墨議論之徒從而撓之，徒激勸忠義無益也。

translations.literal: At that time the favors and posthumous honors were not ungenerous, yet they could not save the state from peril and ruin: court strategy was unsettled, those who ruined affairs were not executed, and men of documents and debate interfered from the side—merely exhorting loyalty and righteousness was of no use.
translations.idiomatic: At that time posthumous honors were generous enough, yet they could not save the state from ruin. Court strategy was unsettled, those who ruined affairs went unpunished, and men of documents and debate interfered from the side. Merely exhorting loyalty and righteousness was of no use.
